title: Simon Four
brief: Four coloured pads flash in a fixed order, then the player taps them in the same order. Three wrong taps lose; four correct taps win.

title: Traffic Light
brief: After a 3-2-1 countdown the light turns green for a moment at a time; tap GO only while it is green. Eight good taps win, three taps on red lose.

title: Drum Pad
brief: A metronome pulses faster in three steps; hit one of three drums right after each pulse. 24 on-beat hits win, four off-beat taps lose.

title: Echo Levels
brief: Three rounds of repeat-the-lights with four pads, each round longer and faster. Finish the last pattern to win, three wrong taps lose.

title: Defuse Timer
brief: A nine-second countdown ticks on a bomb; cut the blue, green and red wires in that order. The wrong wire or zero on the clock blows it up.

title: Falling Notes
brief: Notes fall down three lanes to a rhythm that speeds up; tap each one before it reaches the floor. 20 caught notes win, five dropped ones lose.

title: Swipe Dance
brief: A direction word appears on each beat and the beats get quicker; swipe that way in time. Nine hits win, three misses or wrong swipes lose.

title: Firefly Jar
brief: Fireflies blink a few times and fly off; tap them while they glow but avoid the grey moths. 12 caught fireflies win, three mistakes lose.

title: Lamp Relay
brief: A light runs along five lamps, a little quicker at each one; tap every lamp while it is lit. 15 taps win, three missed lamps lose.

title: Safe Cracker
brief: In three safes a marker slides across a green zone; tap LOCK while it is inside. Crack all three to win, three bad taps set off the alarm.

title: Music Box
brief: Five glowing pads play notes when tapped, and a DEMO button plays a tune. Play 16 notes within 60 seconds to win, otherwise the box runs down.
